definitions.explanation: The act of displaying works of art, products, or other items for public viewing. Most commonly encountered in the compound {展覧会|てんらんかい} (exhibition).

examples.japanese: {展覧会|てんらんかい}に{行|い}く。
{美術|びじゅつ}{展覧会|てんらんかい}のチケットを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought tickets for an art exhibition.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{展覧会|てんらんかい}には、{国内外|こくないがい}から{集|あつ}められた{名画|めいが}が{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: This exhibition displays masterpieces gathered from Japan and abroad.

notes:
Compound of {展|てん} (spread out, display) + {覧|らん} (view, look at). Functions as a する verb ({展覧|てんらん}する = to exhibit), though the compound {展覧会|てんらんかい} is far more common.

USAGE:
Rarely used on its own — almost always appears in the compound {展覧会|てんらんかい} (exhibition, show). The standalone noun {展覧|てんらん} is quite formal and literary. {展覧会|てんらんかい} is the standard word for art exhibitions, museum shows, and similar public displays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {展覧会|てんらんかい} — exhibition, show
- {美術|びじゅつ}{展覧会|てんらんかい} — art exhibition
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}を{開|ひら}く — to hold an exhibition
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}に{出品|しゅっぴん}する — to exhibit (a work) at a show

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {展示|てんじ} — display, exhibition (broader, includes permanent displays)
- {個展|こてん} — solo exhibition (one artist's show)
- {博覧会|はくらんかい} — exposition, world's fair (large-scale, often international)
